name: Date Difference Calculator
description: Calculate the exact difference between any two dates in years, months, and days, plus the total number of days and weeks.
keywords: how many days between two dates

faq.question: Does it matter which date I put first?
faq.answer: No — this always figures out which of the two dates is earlier and measures forward from there, so entering them in either order gives the same result.

faq.question: Why is the years/months/days breakdown different from totalDays / 365?
faq.answer: Because calendar months and years have different lengths (28-31 days, leap years), a calendar-aware breakdown ("6 years, 6 months, 15 days") isn't the same as dividing the total day count evenly. Both the calendar breakdown and the raw total-day count are shown since each answers a different question.
